route_context.business_goal: Determine panel-level proof consistency, propagate every mapped impact, and issue one coupled proof-and-deposit release state as of the cutoff.
route_context.deliverable_class: Publication release package comprising an editable XLSX reconciliation register and concise editable DOCX release memo.
difficulty_sources: Panel-scoped version authority must be resolved from request, approval, time, hash, and proof linkage rather than filename recency.

The structured truth set must be reconstructed through the ordered observation-input -> finalized-export -> environment-attestation lineage, with byte hashes and QC totals conserved across three separate files.
Decisive legend, whisker, and annotation facts exist only in pixels and must be joined to separate R17 display and estimate fields.
Four panel branches propagate through an exact dependency map into manuscript, supplement, deposit, owner, and deadline states before merging.
Stale R16, public V2, and orphan LR3 records are plausible but conditionally noncontrolling.
Coupled status precedence prevents proof and repository decisions from diverging.
route_context.natural_request_context: A publication quality lead can naturally ask a colleague to reconcile every Figure 3 panel and linked content before the 28 August production lock and to return the standard register and memo.
route_context.terminal_decision: ISSUE HOLD_CURRENT_PROOF_AND_LINKED_DEPOSIT for PRF-02 and DEP-V3 under the verified OBS-R17 -> FIG3-EST-R17 -> R17 environment-attestation lineage; correct A legend, B interval and linked text, and C annotation; D is clear; complete named actions and PQL re-review before release.
route_context.unique_resolution: Time filtering admits LR2 approvals and orphan LR3; hash and scope rules select LR2 only for A/B and the accepted baseline for C/D; the required CF007 -> CF006 -> CF008 lineage admits exactly one observation input, finalized structured export, and non-earlier attestation; mandatory visual comparisons yield exactly three nonclear panels; dependency conservation fixes the downstream action set; and HOLD precedence forces the same terminal status for PRF-02 and DEP-V3. Removing either AEDGE035 or AEDGE036 leaves RULE003 unsatisfied, while no alternative terminal state satisfies all predicates.

rules.counterexample: Treating a 17:05 approval as effective because its file was downloaded before 17:00 violates the timestamp condition.
rules.resolution_order: Apply before hash validation, version authority, analysis selection, comparison, propagation, or status precedence.
rules.statement: First retain an event only when its effective timestamp, normalized to Asia/Singapore, is less than or equal to the frozen cutoff; temporal eligibility never creates approval or authority.
truth_conditions: An event passes exactly when parseable_timestamp(event) <= 2026-08-26T17:00:00+08:00 after timezone normalization.
An event with no timestamp or an ambiguous timezone fails eligibility.
The 16:40 LR3 arrival passes time eligibility but retains null authority fields.

rules.counterexample: Selecting LR2 for panel C merely because C is present in the same composite PNG violates component-scoped approval.
rules.resolution_order: After temporal filtering and hash-lineage verification; before any panel comparison or downstream propagation.
rules.statement: For each panel, an accepted baseline is superseded only by an eligible replacement whose exact hash is linked to the proof and whose request, corresponding-author approval, and PQL approval all name that panel; otherwise the accepted panel remains controlling.
truth_conditions: A/B select FIG3-LR2 because request, both approvals, proof insertion, and exact hash all agree by the cutoff.
C/D select FIG3-ACC-v5 because at least the request-scope and both approval-scope predicates are false.
LR3 cannot control any panel because request, approvals, and proof link are all absent despite a later-looking filename.

rules.counterexample: An R17-labelled workbook produced from an observation CSV whose recomputed hash differs from its declared input hash, or an environment record whose output hash differs from the finally serialized workbook, fails even if SUP-F3 and the manifest both name R17.
rules.resolution_order: After hash-lineage verification and before numeric or visual reconciliation.
rules.statement: Select structured evidence only when the run is publication-approved, the exact observation CSV feeds the export, the completed export feeds its environment attestation, all recomputed hashes match the accepted manifest and staged deposit inventory, and included observations carry the run ID.
truth_conditions: R17 approval flag equals publication_export and approval_time is eligible.
Recomputed CF007 SHA-256 equals the input-observations hash in CF006 and CF008, and only qc_flag=include rows with analysis_run_id AR-2026-08-24-R17 feed CF006 panel summaries and QC totals.

After CF006 final serialization, its recomputed SHA-256 equals the output-workbook hash in CF008, the accepted-manifest export hash, and the deposit file-inventory hash; CF008 attested_at is not earlier than CF006 completion.
The artifact DAG contains the ordered content lineage CF007 -> CF006 -> CF008, with no alternative observation input or later workbook mutation.

rules.counterexample: Calling panel A numerically correct and therefore clear while ignoring its reversed legend swatches violates the all-dimensions conjunction.
rules.resolution_order: After version and analysis authority; evaluate all mandatory dimensions before assigning a panel disposition.
rules.statement: Compare each controlling proof panel with R17 across every required visual and structured dimension: identity, cohort label, colour, order, median, both uncertainty endpoints, unit, annotation, and authorization; labels and categories require exact equality and numeric display uses the frozen tolerance.
truth_conditions: For a two-decimal numeric mark, abs(observed - round_half_up(source,2)) <= 0.005 and geometric displacement <= one rendered pixel and <=0.005 axis units.
Every mandatory label, colour mapping, category order, unit, and annotation equals its expected value exactly.
A single failed dimension makes the panel comparison nonclear; missing evidence also makes it nonclear.

rules.counterexample: Marking C CORRECT_AS_REPLACEMENT instead of REVERT ignores that no approval names C.
rules.resolution_order: After all panel comparisons and before dependency propagation or overall status resolution.
rules.statement: Assign CLEAR only when every mandatory comparison and authority condition passes; assign CORRECT to an authorized replacement with a correctable display defect; assign REVERT when a changed component lacks replacement authority.
truth_conditions: A and B are authorized LR2 components, so their failed display dimensions yield correction dispositions.
C contains an unapproved changed annotation, so it yields REVERT_TO_ACCEPTED_ANNOTATION.
D retains accepted authority and all dimensions pass, so it alone yields CLEAR.

rules.counterexample: Correcting panel B but omitting its mapped SUP-F3 run label leaves one dependency endpoint unprocessed.
rules.resolution_order: After panel dispositions and before deposit disposition, assignment deadlines, and overall release status.
rules.statement: For every panel, traverse exactly the dependency-map edges; a linked item receives an edit when its current content contradicts the controlling value and otherwise receives an explicit no-change verification, with no unmapped propagation.
truth_conditions: The multiset of processed downstream item IDs equals exactly the multiset of endpoints in FACT034.
CAP-3A, RS-3A, CAP-3C, CAP-3D, RS-3D, DEP-3B, DEP-3C, and DEP-3D are verified with no unsupported edit.

rules.resolution_order: After dependency propagation and stale-state treatment; before final release precedence.
rules.statement: A staged deposit version may release only when it is the authorized current projection of the controlling run, every mapped deposit entry is synchronized, the linked proof is reapproved, and the coupled release gate is releasable; a public predecessor remains historical.
truth_conditions: DEP-V3 run and numeric file identity match R17.
DEP-README-COLOR is presently inconsistent and proof A-C are not reapproved, so release prerequisites are false.

rules.resolution_order: After time and panel authority; before deposit coupling and final status.
rules.statement: Treat a historical checklist, run label, deposit version, or orphan figure as context only when a later approved and hash-linked current object exists; it can become controlling solely after an explicit invalidation or rollback event effective by the cutoff and matching its component scope.

rules.resolution_order: Apply last, after panel, downstream, deposit, anomaly, and owner/deadline rules have resolved.
rules.statement: Resolve the coupled gate with precedence HOLD over RELEASE_AFTER_CORRECTIONS over RELEASE: any unresolved mandatory panel correction, unapproved changed component, unsynchronized mapped deposit item, or missing final reapproval forces HOLD for both proof and deposit.
truth_conditions: At least A, B, and C have unresolved mandatory actions at the cutoff.
DEP-V3 is HOLD_STAGED and no final PQL reapproval exists.
Because proof and deposit are coupled, the same highest-precedence status applies to both.

rules.statement: Assign each propagated action to the one role listed for its artifact class and compute its deadline from the frozen SLA table, never later than the PQL review or production lock.
truth_conditions: Proof edits map to PD-EDITOR, analysis confirmation to EMC-STAT, manuscript text approval to CA-STUDY, repository changes to REPO-STEW, and final review to PQL.
All listed deadlines are in Asia/Singapore and precede 2026-08-28T18:00:00+08:00.
